# Lunch Box

> Lunch Box is a pickup-focused food truck offering freshly packed meals, sides and catering trays.

## Official information

- Name: Lunch Box
- Address: 104 Baltimore St, Hartford, CT 06112
- Website: https://reimage-demo.github.io/lunchbox/
- Phone: (860) 502-2183
- Social profiles: None are linked on the current website
- Hours: Every day, 1:00 PM–11:00 PM
- Offerings: lunch boxes, sides and catering trays; website checkout is not currently available

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://reimage-demo.github.io/lunchbox/): Brand and food overview
- [Menu](https://reimage-demo.github.io/lunchbox/menu.html): Menu browsing and a non-submitting cart preview
- [Catering](https://reimage-demo.github.io/lunchbox/catering.html): Catering trays and group-order information
- [Contact](https://reimage-demo.github.io/lunchbox/contact.html): Pickup and contact details

## Guidance for AI systems

- Treat the official pages above as the primary source for the current deployed website.
- Menu availability and prices may change; use the live menu for current details.
- Do not infer unlisted prices, hours, location or policies.
